title: research: independently audit all 23 paid-meeting helper cuts
body:
The PR5751 handoff asks whether five paid subdivisions at frame 105 support three independently restorable helper inputs. This separate checker covers that meeting and **all 23 cuts**, using individual rational rows and columns instead of the source matrix-at-cut implementation. It imports no archived constructor, scalar checker or pricing engine.

The rebuilt WORD and complete WITNESS match the source exactly. All **776 input columns / 602,176 coefficients** pass, including nine dirty owned columns and every COPY zero condition. Every cut checks both bases, actual operand frames and the exact restoration modes; no inverse of a potentially singular prefix is used. An invertible two-field counterexample shows why the short cut identities alone are insufficient. The actual source passes the stronger conditions.

The independent recount confirms all 27 added paid queries and 23 added targets per local call. The retained controller gives **66,834 paid calls, 13,390 targets and rank surplus 760**. Both old and new full histograms match their source receipts. Common-format invoices are included for further κ work; the concave-order preflight is inconclusive, as expected. Compiler completion parameters are outside that comparison.

Validation: the normal registered runner and sealed read-only Git-free replay under Python 3.12.14 `-I -O -B` pass. Source corruption rejects; all export bytes and modes stay unchanged. There are 4,369 dense-matrix oracle programs and 20 actual-source negative controls. The exact source export digest matches the source publication, and all six nested manifests are authenticated as data. Metadata, committed bytes/modes and export integrity pass.

[Package](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/tree/30f8cc55c5fd25be59725d0111f5a7bb50e61710/research/p104-meeting-dual-audit), [proof and counterexample](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/30f8cc55c5fd25be59725d0111f5a7bb50e61710/research/p104-meeting-dual-audit/PROOF.md), [receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/30f8cc55c5fd25be59725d0111f5a7bb50e61710/research/p104-meeting-dual-audit/RESULT.json), [validation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/30f8cc55c5fd25be59725d0111f5a7bb50e61710/research/p104-meeting-dual-audit/VALIDATION.md), [canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5764).

Run `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-meeting-dual-audit`.

Scope: scalar cuts, chronology and the declared complete invoice at PR5751 head `8483f9a679d06c1e270141dbc686a7e76e7a7522`. Native phases, physical caller operator equality, moments, compiler, outer admission and the five inherited assumptions remain separate. This is a separate implementation from the same contributing account, not independent human acceptance or a new κ. Full-history ancestry checks are unrun in the shallow checkout; the complete source export is retained for Git-free replay. The selected frontier is unchanged.

Base `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`, priority 8, refreshed before submission. Credit PR5751's construction, flyingviper PR5718, PR5599/5609/5680/5713, Joel Pulikkan/GamingPuzzled PR5684 and every retained predecessor notice. New audit by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0.
